friction.description: No read takes an arbitrary text or file (an arrival) and returns related material; the operator has to translate each capture into search terms by hand.
Inbox captures and Garden seeds are invisible to search, so obvious duplicates (A29 vs inbox:20260816-drf-paper-link.md, A18 vs garden:everything-is-a-dag.md) can only be found by reading.
Substring search returns keyword decoys: 'CAP' matches the simulated-annealing note ('escape'), 'running' matches deadlock/idempotency notes, 'explain' matches project-ledgerline.
material-context ('find saved explanations by need') is about material analyses, not the learner's notes; the name suggests broader retrieval.
